questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:

questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: It was not possible for me to take BA courses as the host institution didn't offer any, however the academic at the MA courses were not difficult and easy to follow.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: More talkative and not as regular law teaching. Teachers were more than I am used to, interested in my personal opinion

questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: "Indigenous peoples rights" and "International criminal law, atrocity wars and transitional justice"

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I would recommend to take "Indigenous peoples rights" and "International criminal law, atrocity wars and transitional justice" as they were relatively easy which meant I has plenty of time to do social activities and discover Tromsø
